raw_segments.text: Z. To obtain a correct idea of the policy pursued by the several states and the Union
with respect to the Indians, it is necessary to consult first.
The laws of the colonial and state governments relating to the Indian inhabitants.
See the legislative documents, 21st Congress, number 319.
2d. The laws of the Union on the same subject, and especially that of March 30, 1802.
See stories, Laws of the United States.
3d. The report of Mr. Cass, Secretary of War, relative to Indian affairs, November 29, 1823.
